zh-CN.title: 投稿协作邀请升级
items: 投稿协作邀请现在通过私聊卡片发送，并展示主题、投稿者与审批者信息
邀请在 7 日内有效，受邀者可在卡片详情中确认加入并查看全部历史消息
投稿者可邀请共同投稿者，审批者可邀请投稿者或审批者，且两种身份保持互斥

en.title: Better submission invitations
items: Submission collaborators are now invited through private message cards showing the topic, authors, and reviewers
Invitations remain valid for 7 days and let recipients confirm before gaining access to the full history
Authors can invite co-authors, reviewers can invite either role, and the two roles remain mutually exclusive
